diagnosis.root_cause: Prior QA established restored tracker dimensions but an 11px vertical drift after scale rollback. Current gameplay_hud.gd updates life-icon minimum dimensions without releasing the life backplate's retained size, then positions the tracker below that actual height. Tracker-only height restoration therefore leaves an upstream layout dependency unresolved. Complete wrapped-content coverage remains missing evidence, separate from the demonstrated position defect.

Restoring only that instance removes the drift; unchanged drift redirects investigation to placement ordering or wrapper binding.
investigation.hypothesis: The life backplate retains its enlarged actual height after rollback, and the tracker inherits that height through relative placement.
investigation.probe: At one fixed short-objective viewport, compare initial and returned life-backplate rect/minimum and tracker rect across the ordered scale sequence. In an isolated Developer diagnostic run, restore only upstream geometry, leaving tracker offsets unchanged; compare the resulting settled placement.
